title: The Oil Rig That Pulled the Plug on a Lake #history #shorts
description:
In 1980, an oil rig drilling in a 10-foot-deep Louisiana lake hit a salt mine. The rig vanished, the lake became a whirlpool, and in about 3 hours Lake Peigneur was gone. Not one person died.

The scenes are an animated dramatization.
